Definition: Identifier corresponding to each individual cell. Included in the data and in every other location to refer to the data (e.g., metadata and annotations). In AnnData files, the ID corresponding to each individual cell is stored in the obs index.
Subsets: data, assigned metadata, calculated metadata, tooling

Definition: ID of the associated feature matrix where the data is stored (if not included in this file). This is used in the Brain Knowledge Platform (BKP) when data is found elsewhere for connected cell to data file.
Link between each cell and each dataset in BKP. In CAS, this is a taxonomy-level variable in uns called `dataset_url`.
The color vector for metadata/taxonomy values in format [COLUMN_NAME]_label. This is ONLY used for molgen-shiny plots. Some metadata files come with these and some do not. This field is OPTIONAL.

The order of metadata values (e.g., the levels of a factor, or ascending order of a numeric). Likely should use “rank” or “order” rather than “id”, since these are not identifiers. Included in the data and in every other location to refer to the data (e.g., metadata and annotations). In AnnData files, the ID corresponding to each individual cell is stored in the obs index.
Additional uncontrolled cell metadata. These are not required, but any additional columns are allowed by all h5ad formats.
Extended metadata about annotations and labelsets stores in JSON.
